text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows computers to think and learn like humans. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data without being told exactly what to do. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large amounts of data to solve difficult problems. Today, AI is used in many parts of daily life. For example, it helps with voice assistants, online shopping recommendations, and even medical diagnosis. AI is changing the world quickly, making our lives easier and smarter.
